observation.finding: No visible governance-panel trigger was present on the rendered page; the panel was not inspectable through the intended access affordance.

rootCause.finding: The published governance-panel runtime contained one literal backslash-n sequence inside executable JavaScript, producing a parse failure before panel initialization.
rootCause.evidence: Repository fetch of assets/compass/compass.governance-platform.js on main showed the literal sequence; local syntax validation after correction passed.

accessControls: edge swipe opens panel from either screen edge

deploymentQualification.reason: Live-domain fetch was unavailable to the audit environment; repository state and syntax were verified independently.
